name: Vlorë
title: Vlorë Ship Gauging | UTM for Ferries and Cargo Ships
description: Ultrasonic thickness gauging at Vlorë, Albania for ferries on the Brindisi crossing, general cargo ships and tankers: hull, decks, holds and tanks.
h1: Ship Thickness Measurement at the Port of Vlorë, Albania
intro: Vlorë is Albania's second port, on a wide bay where the Adriatic meets the Ionian Sea, with seasonal ferries to Brindisi, general cargo and fuel traffic and a growing leisure marina trade nearby. There is no drydock for merchant ships in the bay, so gauging is done alongside or at anchor. Atlantis NDT sends ultrasonic technicians from India for each job and keeps nobody based in Albania.

highlights.p: Ferries run between Vlorë and Brindisi mainly in the warmer months, so a ro-pax ship can be gauged on vehicle decks and ramps between crossings, then taken out of service in winter for deeper work elsewhere.

Small general cargo ships, bulk loads and fuel products reach the port through short calls. Hatch covers, holds and deck piping can be gauged during or just after cargo work, within the berth's safety rules.

highlights.h: A deep bay with an open anchorage
highlights.p: Vlorë Bay has plenty of water and is protected by the Karaburun peninsula, which makes launch-borne condition gauging at anchor a realistic option for pre-purchase and charter checks.

port.h: The port of Vlorë and its bay
p: Vlorë lies in the south of Albania, at the head of a broad bay closed on the west by the Karaburun peninsula and the island of Sazan. The port is where the Adriatic gives way to the Ionian Sea, and the Strait of Otranto, only a short crossing from Italy's heel, lies to the north-west. Winds are moderate in summer and more severe in winter, with southerly gales testing the exposed side of the bay. Depths inside are generous, and the anchorage is large enough for several ships waiting at a time.

Commercial traffic at Vlorë is smaller than at Durrës. General cargo ships bring building materials, food and consumer goods, bulk cargoes arrive for local industry, and fuel products move through the port's liquid cargo facilities. Seasonal ro-pax ferries link the port to Brindisi, carrying passengers, cars and some freight, with peak loading in the summer months when Albanians living abroad return. Pleasure craft and yachts use marinas along the coast, notably at Orikum to the south of the bay, and a military presence remains at the old Pasha Liman site across the water.

The fleet that calls at Vlorë is mixed and often older. Many of the general cargo ships belong to regional owners who trade across the Adriatic and eastern Mediterranean and who value gauging as a basis for sale, charter and docking decisions. With no merchant drydock in the bay, hulls that need steel work sail to Greece, Italy, Croatia or Montenegro. For these ships a gauging record taken at Vlorë, alongside or at anchor, tells the superintendent what to expect before committing to a yard and a date.

facilities.h: Where gauging is practical at Vlorë
p: Most gauging at Vlorë happens alongside. Ships at the commercial quay can open their holds once discharged and let the technicians read hatch covers, coamings, frames and deck plating, with ballast tanks added when the crew has made them safe. Tankers discharging fuel products allow deck and deck piping gauging within the terminal's safety rules, and the ferry berth gives access between crossings. The ship's agent arranges port passes and coordinates with the berth operator, and the plan is adjusted around cargo operations and weather.

At the anchorage, a launch carries the team from the shore to the ship. This is how most pre-purchase, on-hire and off-hire checks are done when a ship waits for a berth or is between employments. When a ship needs a docking the owner will choose a yard abroad, and the technicians can follow the ship there if needed. Shipbuilding and repair capacity in Albania is concentrated elsewhere along the coast and is not suited to full class dockings of merchant ships of any size.
list: Commercial quay at Vlorë: holds, hatch covers and ballast tanks on small cargo ships after discharge
Liquid cargo berth: deck, deck piping and manifold area gauging on small tankers within terminal rules
Ferry berth: vehicle deck, ramp and stern door gauging on the Brindisi service between crossings
Vlorë Bay anchorage: launch-borne condition gauging for pre-purchase, charter and off-hire checks
Follow-on yard dockings abroad: full docking programmes in Greece, Italy or Montenegro after a gauging record at Vlorë

context.h: Regulatory and EU context for ships at Vlorë
p: Albania is not among the Paris MoU's member states, so the regime a ship meets on its Albanian call is national, while the Italian and Greek ports at the end of its usual routes are covered by Paris MoU targeting. Ships on the Brindisi ferry service and cargo ships trading through the Strait of Otranto are therefore inspected at their next EU port under a regime that looks closely at structure, so owners of older tonnage tend to gauge known weak areas between dockings rather than leave them for an inspector to find.

Albania is a candidate for EU membership but not yet a member, which means voyages between Vlorë and EU ports carry part of their emissions under EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime. Owners of older general cargo ships and ferries weigh that alongside steel condition when deciding whether to renew or sell. Gauging records support the decision and the sales file. Entry rules for visiting technicians are Albanian, not Schengen, and we check what applies to Indian citizens at the start of each enquiry.

jobs.h: Typical thickness gauging jobs at Vlorë
jobs.p: Vlorë jobs are short and practical: a cargo ship offers its discharge window, a ferry the time between crossings and an anchored ship whatever the owner arranges. We agree the spaces and the report format with the superintendent before the team leaves India, confirm berth and port access with the agent, and check Albanian entry rules at the same time so that the mobilisation date is realistic.
list: Hold and hatch cover gauging on a general cargo ship at the Vlorë quay once discharged, supporting a sale or charter handover
Deck and deck piping readings on a small product tanker at the liquid berth, within the terminal's safety procedures
Vehicle deck and ramp gauging on the Brindisi ferry between crossings, ahead of a winter docking in Italy or Greece
Pre-purchase condition survey on a cargo ship at the bay anchorage, reached by launch through the agent
Pre-docking steel estimate for a ship about to sail to a yard in Greece, delivered to the yard before arrival

logistics: Tirana International Airport is the main gateway, with a road transfer south to Vlorë, and Corfu and Brindisi are alternatives for arrivals by sea or air. The ship's agent arranges port passes, quay access and a launch for ships at anchor. Albania applies its own visa rules, which are different from the Schengen system, so we check the current position for Indian technicians when an enquiry arrives and plan around the lead time instead of assuming the answer.

faqs.q: Is there a drydock at Vlorë?
faqs.a: Not for merchant ships of any size. Hulls that need steel work normally go to yards in Greece, Italy, Croatia or Montenegro. Gauging at Vlorë beforehand, alongside or at anchor, gives the chosen yard steel estimates for its specification, and the technicians can follow the ship if the owner wants the same team at the docking.

faqs.q: Can a cargo ship be gauged during discharge at Vlorë?
faqs.a: Usually the holds are gauged after discharge, because empty holds give safe access to frames and hatch covers. Deck areas, hatch coamings and some ballast tanks can be gauged during cargo work if the master and the terminal agree. The plan follows the cargo schedule, not the other way round.

faqs.q: Does the seasonal Brindisi service limit when ferries can be gauged?
faqs.a: It sets the windows. In season, ferries are available between crossings, in blocks of a few hours for vehicle decks and ramps. Out of season, more time is available if the ship is laid up or waiting for a docking, so deeper tank work is usually planned for those months.

faqs.q: What entry rules apply to your technicians in Albania?
faqs.a: Albania has its own entry rules for Indian citizens, separate from the Schengen system. We check what applies at the scoping stage, including whether an existing visa is accepted, and add the lead time to the mobilisation plan. Early notice of a Vlorë job is the simplest way to avoid delay.
